content: One modification took QED from 0.290 to 0.823. The central ring runs 4-5-6-17-18-19, so the chlorine on atom 19 is para to atom 6, which carries the arylamine - the correct position for the anilide. Cut the non-ring 19-20 bond and attach an N-linked cyclopropanecarboxamide. That also starts fixing LogP, which is currently 5.37 and far outside drug-like range.
